tei:div.tei:p: karma pa sku phreng lnga pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i lo rgyus/ 3 karma pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i bu slob tshogs/ 44 go'i shri blo gros rgyal mtshan/ 45 'jam dbyangs chen po don grub 'od zer/ 45 go'i shri chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ 48 go shri shākya bzang po/ 50 zhwa dmar sku phreng gsum pa chos dpal ye shes/ 50 ngom pa bya bral ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ 72 sgam po pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ 81 mi nyag rtogs ldan blo gros rin chen/ 81 rje 'di yi slob ma rtoḍa ldan ya brgyad dang 'ja' mi gsum/ 83 bya btang ba'i sku'i skye phreng gnyis pa drung pa leḍa bshad/ 83 mi nyag rtogs ldan grags pa rin chen/ 84 sog dbon rin chen bzang po'i lo rgyus/ 89 karma pa sku phreng drug pa mthong ba don ldan gyi lo rgyus/ 95 karma pa mthong ba don ldan gyi bu slob tshogs/ 106 go shrī dpal 'byor don grub kyi lo rgyus/ 109 kun mkhyen 'jam dpal bzang pa'i lo rgyuso/ 113 karma pa sku phreng bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i lo rgyus/ 123 karma pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i bu slob tshogs/ 191 go'i shri sprul sku/ 193 zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bzhi pa chos kyi graḍa pa/ 194 yangs pa can gyi mkhan rabs dang po shes rab dpal ldan/ 224 mkhan rabs gnyis pa slob dpon dge 'dun bzang po/ 225 mkhan rabs gsum pa chos rje khyam ka ba/ 226 mkhan rabs bzhi pa drung pa legs spyad dpal bzang po/ 226 mkhan rabs lnga pa chos rje karma phun tshogs/ 226 mkhan rabs drug pa ba le pa sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ 227 mkhan rabs bdun pa chos rje do bo ri pa/ 228 mkhan rabs brgyad pa chos rje karma tshul khrims/ 228 mkhan rabs dgu pa ma ṇi ba/ 228 mkhan rabs bcu pa dbon go shrī/ 229 mkhan rabs bcu gcig pa ba le rab 'byams pa/ 229 mkhan rabs bcu gnyis pa chos rgyal pho brang ba/ 230 mkhan rabs bcu gsum pa karma tshul khrims phyi ma/ 230 mkhan rabs bcu bzhi pa bla ma stag tshang pa/ 231 mkhan rabs bco lnga pa karma nyi ma/
